text: Charles Schwab & Co., Inc. International https://click.email.schwab.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTR9AAcAAAAAByw2KJYtXPufiUVyA-39RL7QiX06UfJ7ODBAHKrkQzLZsprkzPD61om313SckENCHQ0UmzqnIZ8y7GpuDLSljHKmlbhOVi_7IvAehRg view on web September 29, 2026 U.S. Investing Brief Stay alert: Don't give fraudsters access to your device. Fraudsters are increasingly using phone calls, emails, and text messages to trick people into granting remote access to their computers, phones, and tablets. Once fraudsters gain access, they may be able to steal personal information, passwords, or financial assets. To stay protected, remember these three simple steps: 1. Stop and think before responding to unsolicited requests. 2. Drop any suspicious communications. 3. Remove unauthorized software if you believe your device has been compromised. Staying informed is one of the best ways to protect your accounts and identity. Explore SchwabSafe(R) for more tips on keeping your account and identity secure. https://click.email.schwab.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTR9AAcAAAAAByw2KJYuhxxJE5RjFezKScG-le4LcsCGLKed5VJfQ34G3-Bl9-Qs2Cx1FFtyGMU4XtDa1Rz5K2wkUQIZ9tX6FqJJi79OEDOAM_-eFsg See SchwabSafe Mark your calendar for upcoming events. Join Schwab’s investing workshops and webinars for timely market insights, portfolio strategies, and educational topics designed to help you make more informed investing decisions. A simpler way to manage alerts and navigate your account. We’ve made updates to international.schwab.com to create a more streamlined experience after you log in to your account. The new Alerts Hub brings alert management into one centralized page, making it easier to review alerts and delivery preferences. We’ve also refreshed parts of the site navigation so you can more easily access account details, portfolio performance, and other important information. https://click.email.schwab.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTR9AAcAAAAAByw2KJYxFxrBBbFklwsqGSCWxTJ_CGbYZ0kEqH-_IkLJwH76EbxAYYPQNohvScaUVEO1GhrVBib2TBGre1CFZb_gyKhd5klSXRT38sY Log in to your account New thinkorswim(R) enhancements designed to support your trading experience. The latest updates introduce several enhancements to help you analyze markets, monitor performance, and navigate the platform more efficiently. New features on thinkorswim desktop include: - Column Sets selector for customizing position columns directly in Active Trader - % Held by Institutions column in watchlists - Multiple My Tools button sets to support your preferred workflow New features on thinkorswim web include: - Portfolio Performance Chart for tracking account performance over time - Expanded scan filters based on chart studies - Updated intraday margin information - Improved audio notifications that can be heard while working in other browser tabs https://click.email.schwab.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTR9AAcAAAAAByw2KJYy2lAzqWnGUKNsXwNG7WLDPFF0GNgor2z6NlNrqSTfuXuF0i6J_oWoKOMoQU1ZNXUkL3RAyCXW6KrjTzQJ1kPOMydubIETWCo See what's new in thinkorswim Schwab monthly stock sector outlook. Where are market opportunities emerging? The latest Schwab Sector Views highlights Industrials, Health Care, Financials, and Materials as sectors that may benefit from key trends such as AI infrastructure investment, technological innovation, and increased capital spending. The report also examines the opportunities and risks across all 11 S&P 500(R) sectors, helping investors stay informed as market conditions evolve. Some examples of Schwab’s sector views include: Industrials: More favored; supported by AI-driven infrastructure investments, data center construction, defense spending, electrification, and reshoring trends. Strong institutional investor interest continues to drive growth. Health Care: More favored; benefiting from aging demographics, biotech innovation, and healthcare technology advancements. Defensive characteristics may help during periods of economic uncertainty.
